## Pages

- [Shoehorn](https://shoehorn.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Shoehorn](https://shoehorn.hexdocs.pm/Shoehorn.md): Shoehorn helps you handle OTP application failures
- [Shoehorn.DefaultHandler](https://shoehorn.hexdocs.pm/Shoehorn.DefaultHandler.md): Default handler that ignores all events

- [Shoehorn.Handler](https://shoehorn.hexdocs.pm/Shoehorn.Handler.md): A behaviour module for implementing handling of failing applications

- Exceptions
  - [Shoehorn.ReleaseError](https://shoehorn.hexdocs.pm/Shoehorn.ReleaseError.md): Error type for release boot script errors
